watch_item: Karpowership Aug-2024 $1B LNG-to-power (FSRU + up-to-500MW powership) investment in Mozambique for the Southern African Power Pool (SAPP). Framed as a NEW SAPP project, but Karpowership references its existing Nacala Bay powership operation - could revive or supersede the shelved Nacala FSRU.
trigger_to_act: Any confirmation that the Aug-2024 SAPP FSRU is sited at Nacala (or replaces the Nacala FSRU project) -> reclassify Nacala from shelved, or open a Discovery record if it is a genuinely distinct new terminal.

watch_item: Matola FSRU FID: targeted for Q2 2025 (energyconnects Oct-2024) but still pre-FID/'being developed' as of Nov-2025 (lngprime).
